name: Round a Go! Go!
source:
This is a fan disc for Liar Soft games, featuring characters from nine of their games as well as the original characters made for this game only.

This world is called Yi Disc. In the name of development its inhabitants gave the control of everything to the machines and the world is about to be destroyed. Machine swallowed almost everyone except a boy and a girl. 

To save the world they summon nine heroes and together they try to save this world...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=427465]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
这是Liar-soft作品的Fan Disc，除了九部旗下游戏的角色外，也有专为本作创作的原创角色登场。

这个世界名为Yi Disc。居民们以发展为名，将一切控制权交给机器，世界也因此濒临毁灭。机器吞噬了几乎所有人，只剩下一名少年与一名少女。

为了拯救世界，他们召唤出九位英雄，并与众人一同设法挽救这个世界……

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=427465]Getchu[/url]]
